**No.** The bundle identifier `is.waiwai.dictation` is permanent. Existing Accessibility grants are tied to it, so a new identifier would make current users lose that permission and need to re-grant it. Sparkle updates would also likely fail to match the old app.

For the launch rename, change the user-facing name to OpenRamble (`CFBundleName` and `CFBundleDisplayName`) and keep the bundle ID. I haven't verified this in the repo, since I have no tools in this session.
